# Sri Explainer

> Premium Comic & Anime Explanations, Recap Stories, and Video Streaming Platform.

## About
Sri Explainer is a specialized streaming and recap platform delivering in-depth comic breakdowns, manga adaptations, anime series explanations, and engaging stories in high definition with clean playback and community interaction.

## Key Features
- **Curated Series**: Complete breakdowns of popular manhua, manhwa, manga, and anime stories.
- **Episode Streaming**: High quality 1080P/4K video playback with instant load times.
- **XP Coin System**: Unlock exclusive premium episodes with earned or purchased XP Coins.
- **VIP Community**: Direct access to WhatsApp and Telegram community discussions.
